answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Work waits on the velvet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the jetty of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the quartz of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
